from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CompanyFinancialMetrics(BaseModel):
    """
    Captures the core financial metrics from a single company's report needed to evaluate 'Mature Phase' criteria.
    """
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name of the company (e.g., 深圳市振业 (集团) 股份有限公司)")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stock code if available (e.g., 000011)")
    report_period: Optional[str] = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g., '2025-Q1'")
    
    # Core financial metrics for the task
    operating_revenue: Optional[float] = Field(description="Operating Revenue (营业收入)")
    net_profit: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders (归属于上市公司股东的净利润)")
    operating_cash_flow: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities (经营活动产生的现金流量净额)")
    capex: Optional[float] = Field(description="Cash Paid for Construction of Fixed Assets, Intangible Assets and Other Long-term Assets (购建固定资产、无形资产和其他长期资产支付的现金)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all company financial metrics extracted from the document collection."""
    companies: List[CompanyFinancialMetrics]
